title: Your daily briefing
summary: Each morning Parachute reads your mailbox, calendar, and matters, then puts the day's work in one place, ranked by what needs you first.
body_markdown:
Parachute now starts your day for you. Each morning it reads your Outlook mailbox, your calendar, and your matters, then opens the new Today page with the day already worked out: a short summary of where things stand, your single top priority, and up to eight ranked work items beneath it.


Every item carries its next action. An email that needs an answer arrives with a draft reply ready to review. A hearing on the calendar becomes meeting prep with one click. Work sitting in a matter takes you straight there.


The ranking thinks like a lawyer. Courts and registries come before opposing counsel, deadlines are only shown when there is real evidence behind them, and everything is grouped by what is overdue, due today, or coming up. Alongside the list, your agenda lays the day out hour by hour with a countdown to your next meeting.


The briefing stays current too. New emails are appended through the day with a New badge, and everything that lands after your briefing shows in the Since your briefing strip.


Your briefing is private to you - it reads your own mailbox and calendar, managed per person and never shared with the firm. Setup takes a minute: connect Outlook, optionally add your calendar, and turn it on. Tomorrow morning your first briefing is waiting.


[See what the daily briefing does](https://goparachute.ai/daily-briefing)
